timeline.text: For two weeks, jobs kept piling up on a site my agent had never seen before.
Unlocking it needed one tap within a two-hour window — and I kept missing it.
So I let the agent grant itself permission, capped at two new sites a day.
It spends that budget on whichever queue is busiest first, before it even wakes up.
Learning one new site costs about 6.8 million tokens — capped, so the backlog finally clears.
